mentions.name: GitHub Audience Atlas
mentions.description: GitHub Audience Atlas visualizes a GitHub user's network on a map, grouping connections by category: followers, following, and ghosts (users who don't follow you back), to answer where a GitHub network is built from.
mentions.source_excerpt: I called it GitHub Audience Atlas. It visualizes a GitHub user's network and shows them on a map by categories: followers, following, and ghosts (those who don't follow you back).
